name: Acutaas Chemicals Ltd
title: Acutaas Chemicals Ltd - 543349 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 revenue INR1,339cr (+33%) and PAT INR356cr; management guides 25% FY27 revenue growth and similar EBITDA margin (~35%), with capex falling to ~INR100cr-odd and utilisation of key plants at 31-75% in Q4.

utilisation.quote: Q4, utilization at Sachin plant is 75% Unit 2 Ankleshwar is 31% and Unit 3 Jagadia is 50%.

capex.quote: Pilot plant capex is slightly delayed due to delay in equipment arrival. It is now expected to get completed by Q2 FY '27.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +40.3% YoY to INR432.8cr
triggers.quote: Revenue from operations for the quarter reached INR432.8 crores, representing 40.3% growth Y-o-Y.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 25% guided
triggers.quote: I'm confident of delivering 25% revenue growth in FY '27.

triggers.label: Q4 utilisation Sachin 75%, Jagadia 50%
triggers.quote: Q4, utilization at Sachin plant is 75% Unit 2 Ankleshwar is 31% and Unit 3 Jagadia is 50%.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~INR100cr, mostly spillover
triggers.quote: our capex will be the sum of the spillover of FY '26 capex, which is around INR50 crores and around INR40 crores will be maintenance capex.

guidance.quote: I'm confident of delivering 25% revenue growth in FY '27.
we are confident in our ability to maintain EBITDA margin at a similar level in the coming year.
the longer -term INR1,000 crore s guidance in CDMO for FY '28 is intact.
it should get completed in second half of calendar year '26.

red_flags.label: Goodwill on Indichem JV INR104cr recoverability
red_flags.quote: the goodwill is recoverable in future

red_flags.label: Working capital days up 114 to 120
red_flags.quote: Our working capital for the year increased to 120 days from 114 days.

red_flags.label: Margin guidance walked back on Q4 level
red_flags.quote: Similar level as FY '26. Q4 is too ambitious.

evasions.quote: I will not put any number to it as of now because there are many variables
I will not put in any figure around the capacity utilization expected in this financial year.
It is very premature to say as of now because it is in a construction phase.
